## Capture And Privacy Checklist

- [ ] Normal capture paths are explicit and traceable through ResourceInbox/raw/source pages.
- [ ] Full Local Capture Mode gates broad capture paths such as browser history, opened documents, clipboard, visited pages, and frontmost app metadata.
- [ ] Sensitive or critical captures are not sent to cloud AI.
- [ ] Optional local tools such as `pixelshot` or PixelRAG integrations fail with clear local status and do not block unrelated text capture.
- [ ] Docs were updated for user-visible capture behavior changes.
